subject: Re: Interregional base fee — EU data residency top-up and baseline rates
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@everatlas.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Baseline hosted API pricing + EU data residency add-on

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. As discussed, EverAtlas is evaluating Redwood for our public-facing summarization API. Before we schedule a technical deep dive, finance needs a straightforward baseline:

- Per-1k-token baseline rate (hosted API) for US region
- Equivalent rate for EU region (if different)
- Explicit EU data residency add-on (one-time setup? recurring?) and how it's billed
- Any minimums or required committed spend to qualify for EU residency

Context: we expect ~150M tokens/month for the first 6 months, spiking in Q2 2027. We are an early-stage startup (Series A) and will need some introductory credit/discount to get through proof-of-concept.

Can you send a concise rate example and call out any one-off fees for residency? If you can attach your latest ratecard, that would be great.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Platform
EverAtlas

Attachments: EverAtlas_SOC2_questionnaire.pdf (see questions 3–7)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@everatlas.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Baseline hosted API pricing + EU data residency add-on

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the SOC2 questions. Looping Vanessa (our account lead) and attaching the Q4 ratecard. Below is a short, explicit example so you can share with finance quickly:

Example (hosted API, token billing):
- US baseline: $0.0065 / 1k input+output tokens
- EU region: +8% region premium = $0.00702 / 1k tokens (same model, routed through EU infra)
- EU data residency add-on: one-time setup $5,000 + $0.0008 / 1k tokens ongoing (for dedicated object storage & audit logs)
- No mandatory committed spend to use residency; reserved capacity discount tiers available for 12/24 month commits.

Startup welcome: we can offer a one-time $10k credit and introductory 15% discount on baseline for the first 3 months (subject to approval).

I'll ask Sales Ops about whether the residency top-up can be absorbed into a committed-rate structure for larger deals — Vanessa, can you advise on the mechanics and whether the one-time setup can be waived for EVR-3241?

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_ratecard_q4_2026.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Baseline hosted API pricing + EU data residency add-on

Marissa & Vanessa — forwarding Olivia's note (EverAtlas, Series A). They want: clear US vs EU baseline, residency add-on structure, and a small startup credit. Quick ask: can we waive the $5k one-time residency setup for a 12-month 40% committed commit? If not, what's the standard concession range? Also advise on whether the 15% intro discount is fine to commit directly or needs revenue ops signoff.

Deal: EVR-3241 — projected 150M tokens/month initial.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Baseline hosted API pricing + EU data residency add-on

Karthik — short answer: we can be flexible but need guardrails. My suggested posture:

- Residency one-time setup ($5k): waive if customer signs a 12-month committed agreement >= $45k/month (net of credits). For a 12-month 40% commit we can amortize setup into the committed rate instead of a separate invoice.
- Ongoing residency per-token adder ($0.0008/1k): cap at +$0.0006/1k for deals > 100M tokens/mo (volume discount).
- Region premium: 8% is reasonable for hosted EU region. For committed deals we can peg to a fixed $/1k that already incorporates the region adjustment.
- Intro credit: approve $10k credit for Series-A POC, additional credits require CRO approval.

Operational notes: include SOC2 evidence link; residency requires KMS & audit log onboarding (customer KMS support takes 2–3 weeks). See attached ratecard for wording.

Approve the public quote to Olivia with those numbers and link to the HubSpot deal; I'll be the approver on credit.

Thanks,
Marissa
VP, Sales Operations

Attachments referenced: Redwood_ratecard_q4_2026.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@everatlas.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quote: baseline hosted API pricing + EU residency options (EVR-3241)

Hi Olivia — per our internal review, please see the concise quote below and attached ratecard. If the numbers look good, we can circulate a simple MSA + SOW that includes the residency option.

Quick quote (hosted API, model: rw-large-v1):
- US baseline rate: $0.0065 / 1k tokens
- EU region premium: +8% -> $0.00702 / 1k tokens
- EU data residency (option A): one-time setup waived if 12-month commit >= $45k/month; otherwise one-time $5,000.
- EU data residency (option B): ongoing adder $0.0008 / 1k tokens; for deals >100M tokens/mo we cap adder at $0.0006 / 1k.
- Introductory support: one-time $10k credit for POC (approved).

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred residency option (A: amortized into commit or B: standalone ongoing adder).
2) I will create HubSpot deal EVR-3241 and attach a sample MSA + SOW.
3) Tech onboarding: SOC2 evidence exchange and KMS handshake (2–3 weeks).

Link to deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/EVR-3241
Ratecard attached: Redwood_ratecard_q4_2026.pdf

If you want we can also run a short cost-projection for your expected 150M tokens/mo and show net monthly spend with and without committed discounts.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_ratecard_q4_2026.pdf

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@everatlas.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quote: baseline hosted API pricing + EU residency options (EVR-3241)

Thanks Karthik — that helps a lot. Quick clarifications:
1) We'll likely go with Option B (ongoing adder) for flexibility; can you confirm the cap would apply once we hit 100M tokens/mo in any month or only when the run-rate is consistently >100M?
2) Please add the $10k POC credit to the HubSpot deal and attach the SOC2 evidence request to the onboarding checklist.

Also — as an early-stage vendor relationship ask: can you confirm that the one-time setup (if it applies) is payable on invoice, not via prepayment, and whether you accept bank transfer / wire in EUR?

If all good, we'll aim to sign the MSA next week and start onboarding in December. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Platform, EverAtlas
